q: Can the homes be sold fee-simple?
a: That is the design intent. The plat is laid out as thirty-eight individual lots, and unit lot subdivision is an active part of the entitlement approach, which is what lets a builder convey each attached home fee-simple rather than as a condominium.

q: What is the six-lot parcel on the frontage?
a: Parcel 1 is the 17,238 SF parcel carrying the General Commercial frontage designation, laid out with six of the thirty-eight lots. It gives a buyer optionality — for-sale, rental hold, or separate disposition — without disturbing the thirty-two lots on parcels 2 through 4.
